# MIT Admissions

> The official admissions portal for MIT providing comprehensive guidance on applications, financial aid, campus culture, and the undergraduate experience.

MIT Admissions serves prospective students, families, and educators with information about first-year and transfer admission processes, financial aid calculators, campus visits, and insights into MIT's educational philosophy and community. The site features student blogs, virtual tours, and resources from the admissions committee to help applicants understand the holistic selection process.

## Key Topics

- MIT Admissions
- First-year admissions
- Transfer admissions
- Financial aid
- Cost of attendance
- Admissions process
- Holistic selection
- Campus visits
- Virtual tours
- CPW (Campus Preview Weekend)
- Student life
- MIT education philosophy
- Need-blind admissions
- Application portal
- Admissions decisions

## Application & Admissions

- [Apply](https://mitadmissions.org/apply): Main application hub for first-year and transfer admissions
- [Our selection process](https://mitadmissions.org/apply/process): Admissions selection process and holistic committee evaluation
- [First-year eligibility](https://mitadmissions.org/apply/firstyear): First-year applicant eligibility requirements and criteria
- [Transfer eligibility](https://mitadmissions.org/apply/transfer): Transfer admission eligibility and residency requirements
- [Be yourself!](https://mitadmissions.org/apply/prepare): Application preparation guidance and personal context advice
- [Advising your students](https://mitadmissions.org/apply/parents-educators): Guidance for parents and educators on college advising

## Financial Aid & Affordability

- [Afford](https://mitadmissions.org/afford): Financial aid overview with cost affordability and aid calculator
- [How much it costs](https://mitadmissions.org/afford/cost-aid-basics/access-affordability): Cost of attendance and need-blind financial aid information
- [How to apply for aid](https://mitadmissions.org/afford/cost-aid-basics/how-to-apply-for-aid): Financial aid application process with FAFSA and CSS Profile
- [Estimate your cost](https://mitadmissions.org/afford/cost-aid-basics/financial-aid-calculators): Net Price Calculator and cost estimation tools

## Discover MIT

- [Discover](https://mitadmissions.org/discover): Main discovery page covering MIT culture, financial aid, and student life
- [Basic facts](https://mitadmissions.org/discover/about-mit): MIT basic facts, institution overview, and campus information
- [MIT's educational philosophy](https://mitadmissions.org/discover/the-mit-education): MIT's educational philosophy and core learning principles
- [The MIT community](https://mitadmissions.org/discover/life-culture): MIT community culture, diversity, and undergraduate experience

## Campus Visits & Engagement

- [Visit](https://mitadmissions.org/visit): Campus visit information with tours and info sessions
- [Schedule your campus visit](https://mitadmissions.org/schedule-your-visit): Campus visit registration and tour scheduling
- [Online info sessions](https://mitadmissions.org/online-info-sessions): Virtual info sessions and interactive campus exploration
- [Explore MIT on your own](https://mitadmissions.org/explore-on-your-own): Self-guided virtual tour and academic exploration resources

## Home & News

- [MIT Admissions](https://mitadmissions.org): MIT Admissions homepage with application portal and admissions overview
- [Newsletters](https://mitadmissions.org/discover/learn-more): MIT Admissions newsletters and campus news subscriptions
